## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title follows Conventional Commits, for example `fix: keep captions inside the safe area`.
- [ ] Local checks from CONTRIBUTING.md pass.
- [ ] Bundled third-party skills are unchanged, or the change is a deliberate upstream update with `tests/bundled.sha256` regenerated.
- [ ] New assets are recorded in `skills/scene-flow/assets/SOURCES.md` with a license that allows redistribution.
- [ ] Docs are updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] Version numbers and `CHANGELOG.md` are not edited by hand.
